model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 13 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 日下 j99:24a '南海淀之東二里許有保福寺' (bell of 1611, pagoda of the monk Wen Nai). 八旗通志 names the 正蓝旗 camp by it. Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 2500,705, fit rms 95 m (Paofusze), 460 m from the point used.
